description: The statistics registry (docs/specs/2026-11-13-statistics.md): what a statistic node's values ARE (measures) and how they were estimated (methods). A statistic is computed FROM a partition's members over a span of a field (field -> selection/measurement -> statistic). A name here is what a producer writes and a reader asks for; a new kind of statistic adds an entry.

measures.name: power_density
measures.description: power per hertz: a power spectral density (Welch's density; Brainstorm's PSD, Measure 'power')

measures.name: covariance
measures.description: the zero-lag second moment of the rows over a span, [rows x rows] real (the zero-lag case of the cross-spectrum): a noise or data covariance. Its inverse square root, the whitener, is an operator derived from it

measures.name: power
measures.description: power: the mean square of the field or of a band of it

measures.name: relative_power
measures.description: a band's power over the total power (0 to Nyquist): unitless

measures.name: cross_spectral_density
measures.description: the cross-spectrum of the rows, Hermitian [rows x rows] per frequency or band (components re, im)

measures.name: cross_spectrum
measures.description: the cross-spectrum of the rows per bin (Welch's spectrum or chain scaling), Hermitian [rows x rows] (components re, im)

measures.name: cross_spectrum_sum
measures.description: per member of a partition (a window), the sum over its samples of z z^H of a band's analytic signal: Hermitian [rows x rows] (complex); the mean is sum / count at read

measures.name: fourier_coefficient
measures.description: the one-sided Fourier coefficient (unscaled, no window) of each time tile at the bins of a frequency span, read through a spatial operator (a mode basis, a kernel): [tiles x bins x rows] (complex); every second-order quantity (a cross-spectrum, power, phase current) is a quadratic form of it

measures.name: amplitude
measures.description: the mean |z| of a band's analytic signal

measures.name: scale_event
measures.description: the cross-pair event (its ordinal) that a pair's event belongs to, NaN beyond the pair's events: unitless

measures.name: stokes
measures.description: the tangential Stokes parameters of a current's band cross-spectral tensor in the canonical frames: [S0, S1, S2, S3] (a quaternion)

measures.name: share
measures.description: a part's share of a whole (the power along the normal over the trace): unitless

measures.name: quadrature_energy
measures.unit_rule: (the field's unit)^4 (a product of two spectra)
measures.description: per source, the sum over the other sources of (Im C)^2: its share of the quadrature (zero-lag-free) part of the cross-spectrum

measures.name: quadrature_pattern
measures.description: a quadrature pair's pattern (p or q; p leads q by a quarter cycle), unit-normed over the kernel's rows

measures.name: speed
measures.description: a phase speed (a tile's centre speed 2 pi f / mu)

measures.name: quadrature_fraction
measures.description: ||Im C||_F / ||C||_F of a cross-spectrum: the travelling-vs-standing indicator (unitless)

measures.name: count
measures.description: how many values fall in each bin (a histogram)

measures.name: probability
measures.description: the share of values in each bin (a normalised histogram)

measures.name: percentile
measures.description: the value below which a given share of the values lies

measures.name: mean
measures.description: the mean over the members (a group mean, a span mean)

measures.name: cycle_pattern
measures.description: the leading eigenvectors of a band's cross-spectrum read through a kernel's forms, as complex fields (stream function, potential, normal current on the glued surface; coefficients on the eigen axis): the most consistent cycle patterns, Re(m e^{i phi}) over a cycle; a phase origin is free

measures.name: cycle_pattern_lags
measures.description: the lags of a cycle pattern's fields read as a phase 1-form on the intrinsic edges: the timing map (s), the phase speed (m/s) and the inconsistency (a share)

measures.name: phase_lag_split
measures.description: a band's phase field (each intrinsic edge's lag of a cross-spectrum, a 1-form) split at a spatial scale: on the glued surface the timing map (s), its propagation (rad/m), the phase speed (m/s), the stream function (rad) and the inconsistency (a share) per vertex; on the eigen axis the 1-form's coefficients in the modes' 1-forms

measures.name: repeat_dot
measures.description: per tile, the dot product of two runs' mean resultant crossing vectors (the vortex cores' direction in the tile, senses pooled): large only when both runs are consistent and agree, negative when they go opposite ways, NaN where a run has too few crossings (unitless)

measures.name: repeat_cosine
measures.description: the whole recording's count-weighted mean cosine of the tiles' crossing directions between two runs (tiles with enough crossings in both): 1 the same direction in every tile, 0 unrelated, -1 reversed (unitless)

measures.name: power_sum
measures.description: the sum of |z|^2 of an analytic band signal over a set of channels and a time tile's good samples, with the number of values: the mean band power of the tile (the lag-free null's envelope) is derived at read

measures.name: crossing_sum
measures.description: a lag-free null draw's crossings of the tiles: per stage and sense, per tile (the callosal bridge last), the sum of the crossings' unit vectors (x y z, tangent at the tile centre) and their number: what `tile_crossings` stores as a measurement for the data

measures.name: null_p
measures.description: per tile, the sequential (Besag-Clifford) p-value of a statistic against the lag-free null's draws, its Benjamini-Hochberg q over the tiles and the number of null draws at least as large (NaN where the data's statistic is undefined; unitless)

measures.name: crossing_ratio
measures.description: per tile, the data's number of crossings over the lag-free null's mean number (NaN where the null has none): where it is far from 1 the null does not make the same crossings, and a consistency compared with it is compared at different counts (unitless)

measures.name: null_resultant
measures.description: per tile, the lag-free null's mean resultant crossing vector over its draws (the senses pooled; x y z, tangent at the tile centre, length 0 to 1) and its mean number of crossings: what a group map subtracts (the project's MODE=excess)

measures.name: patch_summary
measures.description: the patches of a band's relative power over a set of frames: counts by area (log bins), by characteristic level and by patches per frame, with the good frames scanned and the patches found; the same form for the burst frames and for the frames outside them (the noise reference)

measures.name: null_fraction
measures.description: per vertex, the lag-free null's mean fraction of the burst frames the vertex lies in a patch over its draws (0 to 1): what a home map is read against

measures.name: null_size
measures.description: the size distribution of the spatial events against the lag-free null: per entry (the share of the patches at a characteristic level or in an area bin, the patches per frame) the data's value, the null's mean, the two one-sided sequential p-values and their Benjamini-Hochberg q

measures.name: point_spread
measures.description: the instrument's blur for a unit current at a sample of vertices (x, y and z separately) through a stored head model and inverse kernel, read by the spatial events' chain: per source and orientation the peak's distance from the source (cm), the patch's equal-area diameter (cm) and area (cm2), the characteristic level and its size (cm) and the peak power

measures.name: principal_components
measures.description: the principal components across the members of a table: unit-length loadings [component x features], every component up to the table's rank, each with its largest loading positive (nxr::pca; unitless)

measures.name: principal_scores
measures.unit_rule: (the input's unit); unitless when scaled to unit variance
measures.description: the members' scores on the principal components, U S [member x component]: the centred (and scaled) table on the components

measures.name: explained_variance
measures.unit_rule: (the input's unit)^2; unitless when scaled to unit variance
measures.description: per principal component its singular value, explained variance (S^2 / (n - 1)) and the share of the table's total variance (the ratio, unitless)

measures.name: pca_centring
measures.description: the mean removed from each feature of the table and the divisor applied after it (1 unless scaled to unit variance), the two rows a reconstruction needs

measures.name: identification_correlation
measures.description: Pearson's r between each member's target feature vector and every member's database feature vector, each vector z-scored across its features (brain fingerprinting; unitless) [target member x database member]

measures.name: self_identifiability
measures.description: per member its self-correlation r_ii and its self-identifiability D_self: how far r_ii stands above the member's correlations with the others, in their standard deviations (unitless)

measures.name: identification_accuracy
measures.description: the share of members identified: target from database (the largest r of a row on the diagonal), database from target (of a column), and chance 1/n (unitless)

measures.name: edgewise_reliability
measures.description: per feature, on the z-scored feature vectors: ICC(1,1) of the two measurements, Finn's differential power and the group consistency (unitless)

measures.name: amplitude_envelope_correlation
measures.description: Pearson's correlation of the amplitude envelopes |z| of every pair of rows over a span, [rows x rows] (a band's connectome; MEG fingerprinting, Brainstorm's AEC without orthogonalisation; a [rows x rows x bands] stack for a person's connectome feature): unitless

measures.name: identification_curve
measures.description: per number of principal components: the identification of the PCA reconstructions of the stacked target and database, accuracy both ways and the mean self-identifiability

measures.name: flow
measures.description: the flow of a weighted cross-spectrum per frequency member and band pair: power, phase current per edge and per vertex, Hodge-Dirac flow coefficients, potential and stream

measures.name: time_cell_flow
measures.description: the sums over an atom's time cells of the edge and vertex phase currents and the power

measures.name: consistency
measures.description: the resultant length R1 of a direction's unit vectors over time cells, with its sign-flip p values

measures.name: aperiodic
measures.description: the aperiodic background's parameters of a spectrum: offset, exponent, knee, r2, points used

methods.name: sample
methods.description: the sample covariance: the products of the samples (the mean of each block removed unless the options say otherwise), summed over the span's blocks and divided by dof (Brainstorm bst_noisecov, MNE compute_raw_covariance)

methods.name: empirical
methods.description: computed elsewhere and imported (an MNE -cov.fif, a Brainstorm noise covariance): its values as the producer gave them, its provenance in the options

methods.name: welch
methods.description: the mean over a segment partition of each segment's tapered periodogram (Welch 1967; scipy.signal.welch, Brainstorm bst_psd)

methods.name: analytic
methods.description: sums over a tile partition of products of a band's analytic signal (the cycle-pattern spec, stage 1)

methods.name: histogram
methods.description: counts over a tile partition in fixed bins (nxr::histogram: nxr's _core_threshold, 4096 log bins)

methods.name: percentile
methods.description: read off a parent distribution (the upper edge of the bin where the cumulative share reaches p)

methods.name: mean
methods.description: the mean over the partition's members

methods.name: occupancy
methods.description: per element, the number of good frames in which it lies inside an event and the number of good frames: the fraction is derived at read (a home map; nxr-neuro, spatial events)

methods.name: phase_split
methods.description: a 1-form on the intrinsic edges split into its exact (curl-free) part, its coexact (divergence-free) part and the rest, by inner products with the modes' 1-forms or a weighted fit (a global fit: no additive form)

methods.name: spectral_coefficients
methods.description: each time tile's one-sided transform (unscaled, no window) at the bins of a frequency span, read through a composed spatial operator (a mode basis with a kernel or a channel map): one value per tile, bin and row, nothing summed

methods.name: eigendecomposition
methods.description: the leading eigenvectors of a statistic read through a linear map (a decomposition of a statistic, never of a field: the cycle patterns of a windowed cross-spectrum sum)

methods.name: summary
methods.description: summaries of a measurement over its partition's members, per row, pooled or of the mean over rows: mean, sd, median, mad, percentile, peak, kurtosis, skewness, min, max (nxr::stats; spec docs/specs/2026-11-13-statistic-summaries.md); the measure is the measurement's

methods.name: run_repeat
methods.description: the agreement of two runs' tile crossings of the vortex cores (nxr vortex_cores.repeat, tile_dot): a statistic over two runs' measurements, never a recording; its p-value comes from the lag-free null (nxr-neuro, spec piece 8)

methods.name: power_tiles
methods.description: the band power in dyadic time tiles of the recording's line (a reduction over a time partition, folded chunk by chunk): sums and counts, the mean derived at read

methods.name: lagfree_null
methods.description: one draw of the lag-free surrogate (the data's spectrum, zero-lag covariance and envelope, no lag): the same chain as the data's, run on the surrogate (nxr-neuro `surrogate_lagfree_vortex`, `surrogate_lagfree_spatial_events`; spec docs/specs/2026-11-17-surrogates.md)

methods.name: besag_clifford
methods.description: a p-value from sequential Monte Carlo draws (Besag and Clifford 1991): sampling stops at h exceedances (h / n) or at the maximum number of draws ((exceedances + 1) / (n + 1)); the nxr-neuro lag-free surrogates' comparisons

methods.name: patch_statistics
methods.description: the counts that describe a set of spatial-event patches (area, characteristic level, patches per frame), accumulated frame by frame (nxr-neuro `patches`)

methods.name: lagfree_pairs
methods.description: a test of a burst's second moment against lag-free Wishart draws of its own zero-lag second moment (no lag, the burst's degrees of freedom): the lag-free surrogate of the second-moment measures (nxr-neuro `surrogate_lagfree_pairs`, node `surrogate.lagfree_pairs`)

methods.name: histogram2d
methods.description: counts over a grid of two axes (a joint histogram, e.g. the phase joint: spatial phase against temporal phase), added across chunks; each column is normalised at read, never stored

methods.name: sum
methods.description: the sum over the partition's members of what the measure is (e.g. the Stokes vector of a mode pair summed over the samples); a ratio of sums (the mean state) is derived at read

methods.name: sphere_histogram
methods.description: counts of unit directions over the equal-area cells of the sphere (the Lambert disc about +z of nxr.measure.densities.head_sphere, the Globe's cells), added across chunks: the density of a pair's Stokes states on the Poincare sphere

methods.name: pearson
methods.description: Pearson's correlation from the rows' covariance over the span: C_ij / sqrt(C_ii C_jj) (MATLAB corrcoef, Brainstorm bst_corrn)

methods.name: fingerprint
methods.description: the identification of a cohort's members from two measurements each (da Silva Castanheira et al. 2021, Nat Commun 12:5713; after Finn et al. 2015 and Amico & Goni 2018): z-scored feature vectors, their Pearson correlation, accuracy both ways, self-identifiability, edgewise reliability and the PCA reconstruction curve (nxr::stats identification.h)

methods.name: pca
methods.description: the principal components across the members of a table of measurements (members x features), by the thin SVD of the centred table: components, singular values and explained variance, scores, the centring; reconstruction at k components is derived at read (nxr::pca; `compute pca`)

methods.name: scale_selection
methods.description: the links of a scale selection: for each pair's event (a labelling's member) the cross-pair event it belongs to, events matched across (spatial level, time level) pairs by the ladders' nesting in space and overlap in time (nxr-neuro `scaleselection`; Rheome detect.blobscale)

methods.name: point_source
methods.description: unit point sources planted at vertices and read back through a stored forward model and inverse kernel (the resolution matrix's columns): the instrument's blur, a reference measurement (nxr-neuro `pointspread compute`)

methods.name: chunk_spectra
methods.description: each chunk's spectrum in a surface's field coordinates, the chunk taken in with an overlap on each side (reflected at the recording's ends), one transform, no window, no taper, no zero padding: the cross-spectrum in its exact factored form (nxr-neuro `sensor_flow`)

methods.name: spectral_flow
methods.description: the flow of a weighted cross-spectrum in a surface's field coordinates per frequency member (an atom or a bin), whole field and band pairs: power, phase current per edge and per vertex, Hodge-Dirac flow coefficients, potential and stream (nxr-neuro `sensor_flow`)

methods.name: atom_time_cells
methods.description: the sums over each atom's own time cells (a dyadic level of the time line) of the edge and vertex phase currents and the power, per atom and band (nxr-neuro `sensor_flow`)

methods.name: sign_flip_consistency
methods.description: the sign-flip (time-reversal) test of a direction's consistency over time cells: R1 per element, per-element and family-wise p, the median and its null (nxr's flow maps flip_test; numpy default_rng)

methods.name: sensor_power
methods.description: each vertex's power per bin from chunk spectra in field coordinates: the mean over the chunks of the synthesised field's squared magnitude

methods.name: aperiodic_fit
methods.description: the aperiodic background of each spectrum: specparam's aperiodic model without or with a knee (nxr's nxr.spectral.aperiodic)
